content: Sipi ꞌadi ꞌali ꞌana ona semalimali
Ta Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya, ꞌabo yaita sipi ꞌadi ꞌali ꞌawanega nigeya ꞌilugulugu ta mali senega ꞌimwela taona, tauna tuga toꞌipwala.
Ta ꞌeguma yaita sipi ꞌidi ꞌawa ꞌenega ꞌilulugu, tauna sipi ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila,
manuna ꞌidi ꞌawa nina ꞌana toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌawa ꞌigigegena be toꞌitaꞌiꞌita sipi nina ꞌilulugu be ꞌina sipiyao ꞌadi esanega ꞌibwauyedi, ta ꞌenana sinono be ꞌenega simuliye ta siapwesa ꞌatamanaya.
Niꞌatu maiboꞌadi siapwesa, ta ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌinugana be simulimuliye, manuna ꞌenana simwalatonina ta niꞌatu sipanaitena.
Ta sipi nidi geyaꞌabo mali tomota simulimuliyedi, ta ꞌediyega sida dena, manuna ꞌenadi nigeya simwalamwalatonidi ta wate nigeya sipanapanaitedi.”
Ona semalimali gete Yesu ꞌisimanena ꞌediya, ta yage nina manuna ꞌionaona nigeya ꞌimaemaedana taudi ꞌediya.
Yesu tauna toꞌitaꞌiꞌita sipi
Ta Yesu ꞌediya ꞌionalimana, ꞌigwae, “Yaona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌemiya, ꞌaboꞌagu sipi ꞌidi ꞌawa nina.
Ta lowa togimi ꞌitaꞌiꞌita nidi, taudi toꞌipwala, ga sipi nigeya ꞌenadi sida nonona.”
ꞌEnega wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu tuga ꞌawa nina, be ꞌabo yaita tauna ꞌeguyega ꞌiluguma ꞌida boboꞌana, manuna tuta yauna ꞌiluguluguma be ꞌiapweapwesa ta pwatula boboꞌana ꞌilobaloba.
Ta toꞌipwala taudi tuga ꞌidi guinuwa nate simamai be siꞌiꞌipwala ta siloemwawasa ta wate sigietoꞌumali, ta ꞌaboꞌagu yamai be ꞌenega tomota yawasidi boboꞌana ta maamaana ꞌeguyega sida loba.”
Ta wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “ꞌAboꞌagu sipi ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita boboꞌana, ꞌenega yawasigu yatagwalena be ꞌigu sipiyao manudi yamwamwawasa.

Ta ꞌabo yaita nigeya tonisipi, ta maisa manuna ꞌietoꞌitaꞌiꞌita, be ꞌabo kedewa bosasa ꞌiꞌita ꞌimeema, sipi nidi ꞌipilisinedi ta ꞌidedena. Ta kedewa nina sipi ꞌaidi ꞌiloemwawasidi, be matautega sipi maiboꞌadi siꞌelelewana.
Tai nina ꞌina dena ꞌalena tuga maisa manuna ꞌipaipaisewa, ta sipi nidi mali tai ꞌina sipiyao, ꞌenega nigeya manudi ꞌinuwanuwa.
ꞌEnega wate ꞌieonedi, “ꞌAboꞌagu sipi ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita boboꞌana, manuna ꞌigu sipiyao yamwalamwalatonidi ta taudi simwalamwalatonigu.
Nadigega tuga Tamagu ꞌimwalatonigu ta ꞌaboꞌagu wate yamwalatonina. Ta wate ꞌaboꞌagu yawasigu niꞌatu yatagwalena be ꞌigu sipiyao manudi yamwamwawasa.

ꞌAina wate ꞌigu sipiyao simiyami, nate taudi gete tuga nigeya ꞌigu ꞌali ꞌena simiyami, taudi sipi nidi yatootoodi be ꞌeguya yameꞌedi be ꞌenega ꞌenagu sinono ta simama ꞌeguya, be magosediyao sida eboda ꞌebweuna, ta ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌebweuna tuga.
“Tamagu ꞌioboboma ꞌaiꞌailigu manuna yawasigu yatagwalena be ꞌaene yamwamwawasa, ꞌenega maꞌetamo yawasigu wate yada lobalimai.

Nigeya ꞌebweu yaita ꞌiloiloinegu be yamwamwawasa. Taugu tuga yatagwalegu be yamwamwawasa, ta sawesaweguya be yawasigu yaꞌewa limai. Manuna gete nadigega Tamagu ꞌina nuwena, ta wate ꞌina loina ꞌeguya.”
Ta Yesu ꞌina ona gete manudi ga me Yudia nidi wate taudimo ꞌediya siegewagewana sinabwana, ꞌenega weyala ꞌediya ꞌiapwesa.
Ga tomota yau wawasae sigwae, “Tauna yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌenaya, ga ꞌigiekabaleyena. Geyaꞌabo ꞌina ona wanoonodi.”
Ta ꞌaidi wate sigwae, “Gete nigeya nadigega yaluyaluwa biꞌi ꞌina ona, ta mwaꞌadega ga waona ꞌaene yaluyaluwa biꞌi sawesawenaya be tomata kebokebo matana ꞌida gieꞌesasadi? Nigeya sawesawenaya!”
Me Yudia Yesu siguitoyasena
Tuta nina gogai ꞌana tutaya ꞌebweu sagali siguinuwena, nate Anuwa Tabu ꞌana gieꞌesasa manuna.
Tuta nina ꞌena Yesu Anuwa Tabu solanaya ꞌilopili dadana, ꞌebweu pitaupa ꞌenaya, nate sieesena Kini Solomoni ꞌina ꞌaliupa.
Ga gote ꞌena me Yudia nidi Yesu siasakowasiyena ga sieonena, sigwae, “ꞌOyo tuta yauna ꞌugiegie nuwanaluwema, ta to tuta ꞌena be ꞌenega ꞌemaya ꞌuda simana ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌaene ꞌoyo Toꞌetoseyana nina?”
Ga Yesu ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Niꞌatu ꞌemiya yasimana ta esi nigeya waemiemisegu. Ta wate guinuwa nidi Tamagu ꞌana esanega yaguinuwediya ꞌediyega niꞌatu sieꞌitaegu,
ta tuwa tuga nigeya wada emisegu, manuna ꞌomi nigeya ꞌigu sipiyao.
Ta ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌigu sipiyao ꞌenagu sinonona, ta taudi wate yamwalatonidi ga ꞌenega simulimuliyegu,
ta yawasidi ataya yaꞌebwaꞌedi be ꞌenega geyaꞌabo sitoꞌutoꞌumali, ta wate geyaꞌabo ꞌebweu yaita nimaguyega ꞌiꞌoaeꞌoaegu.
Taudi sipi nidi Tamagu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌeguya ꞌenega geyaꞌabo yaita saꞌi Tamagu nimanega ꞌiꞌoaeꞌoaena, manuna tauna yage yauyauna ꞌiloetana sinedi.
ꞌAboꞌagu be Tamagu ꞌebweuna tuga.”
ꞌEnega me Yudia nidi wate gulewa siꞌewedi ga ꞌaene Yesu sida loemwawasi.

Ta Yesu ꞌiꞌitedi ga ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Guinuwa yaudi ta boboꞌadi Tamagu ꞌenega niꞌatu yaguinuwedi ꞌemiya, ta to guinuwa sana manuna wanuwanuwa ꞌaene toꞌumalina, ga ꞌenega ꞌaene gulewega wada loemwawasigu?”
ꞌEnega me Yudia nidi Yesu ꞌina ona sieꞌisena, sigwae, “Nigeya ꞌaene ꞌimu guinuwa boboꞌana manudi ꞌaunuyo, ta esi ꞌimu ona oopaꞌala manuna. Manuna ꞌoyo tai tuga ta ꞌuona ꞌaene ꞌoyo Yaubada.”
Ta Yesu wate ꞌediya ꞌigwae, “Loina ꞌetoꞌetoladina ꞌimi Buki Tabu solanaya, ꞌigwae, ‘Niꞌatu yaona ꞌaene ꞌomi yaubada nimi.’
Ta tamwalatonina ꞌaene Buki Tabu ꞌina simana maiboꞌana nigeya kabo, ta Buki Tabu nadigega ꞌina simana be ꞌaene taudi Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌiꞌebwaꞌediya ꞌieesedi yaubadao.

ꞌEnega toꞌase ꞌalena tuta nina yagwae, ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Yaubada natuna, ga ꞌigu ona nina manuna wanuwena ꞌaene ona oopaꞌala? Ta ꞌaboꞌagu ꞌiesinuwegu ta ꞌietuneguma ga baleꞌuya yamai be ꞌina guinuwa yada guinuwei.
“ꞌEnega ꞌeguma wanuwena ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Tamagu ꞌina guinuwa nigeya yaguiguinuwei, geyaꞌabo waemiemisegu.

Ta esi ꞌeguma wanuwena ꞌaene guinuwa nidi yaguiguinuwedi, ta nigeya waemiemisegu, tuwa tuga guinuwa dimo wada emisedi, be gote ꞌenega sida giesana ilemi be wada mwalatonigu ꞌaene ꞌaboꞌagu Tamagu ꞌeguya ꞌimiyami, ta ꞌaboꞌagu wate Tamagu ꞌena yamiyami.”
Gote ꞌena me Yudia nidi wate sitoona be ꞌaene sigiyai, ta esi ꞌipili sinedi.
ꞌEnega ꞌitauya ga Yolidani bwasina ꞌiabala limena, nate Yoni ꞌina ꞌebe giebapitaiso lowa senanaya, ga nada ꞌiloꞌasa,
ga gote ꞌena tomota yaudi ꞌenaya simai ga taudimo ꞌediya sigwae, “Yoni nigeya ꞌebweu guinuwa waiwaina ꞌiguiguinuwedi, ta esi Yoni ꞌina simana tai gete manuna ꞌaiꞌailina ꞌiapwesama.”
ꞌEnega sena nina ꞌena tomota yaudi Yesu siemisena.
